bridges.prompt: Inside the glass-walled manager's office with dark wood desk and harsh fluorescent ceiling panels. The manager slides the folder across the desk and says firmly: "I'm sorry Marcus, but your position has been eliminated." Marcus's expression shifts from attentive to shock. His jaw tightens, eyes widen. The camera pushes in slightly toward his face as he processes the news.

Inside the glass-walled manager's office. Marcus takes a slow breath, nods once, and says quietly: "I understand." He pushes himself up from the mesh chair with dignity, straightening his charcoal suit jacket. The manager remains seated behind the dark wood desk, looking away. Marcus turns toward the glass door.

Marcus walks from the glass-walled manager's office into the open-plan office with rows of gray desks and fluorescent ceiling panels. He passes a few coworkers who glance up then quickly look away. He reaches his own workstation desk and begins placing personal items into a cardboard box.

At his workstation desk in the open-plan office under fluorescent ceiling panels. Marcus picks up the packed cardboard box, tucks it against his chest. A coworker at a nearby desk says softly: "Hey man... I'm sorry." Marcus nods without looking up and turns to walk down the aisle between the rows of gray desks.

Marcus walks through the office aisle between rows of gray desks toward the glass exit. He pushes through the revolving glass door with his shoulder, stepping from the harsh fluorescent interior into the gray overcast daylight outside onto the concrete plaza. The light shifts from cold indoor fluorescent to cold outdoor overcast.
